title: fix(ui): let each page decide its sidebar
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pages without a list of their own (Usage, Knowledge and other plugin pages) still show a sidebar, the ⋯ item reads as current when it is not, and opening Automations flashes its old list page for a frame.

## User Impact

Each page decides its sidebar: pages without one show only the rail and hide it at once; clicking the current section returns to its start; ⋯ is active only while its menu is open; Automations and Dashboards open without the flash.

## Why This Change Was Made

Moves the which-sidebar decision to the page's route and makes the shell the owner of whether a section's sidebar stands beside its page, so the page knows before its first frame. The saved collapse preference is never changed by navigation.

## Evidence

Screenshots come from the Control UI mock at the end of the series, so the after image can show later parts too.

Usage before and after: only the rail beside it (left: main, right: after):

![Usage before and after: only the rail beside it](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/efe28841-c9b1-43be-84f9-86e7cad79b29)

- `pnpm tsgo:ui` passes at this PR's head.
- The unit tests of the files this PR touches pass at its head; the full UI unit suite passes at the end of the series (one failure also on main: a Workboard German relative-time string, "vor 1min", from the local ICU).
- Local autoreview (Codex) over the whole series; its three findings are fixed in this series.
- The full UI e2e suite was not run locally.


## Update: Dashboards stays a gallery

Dashboards is now a page without a sidebar, like Usage, so the rule that kept the Dashboards list beside a dashboard opened from it is gone.

Side rail series, part 10 of 16. Stacked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199830; review only this PR's commits.


## Update: e2e repair

The full Control UI e2e run on the stack found tests this PR broke or product gaps it introduced; this PR now carries their fixes:
- fix(ui): list automations and dashboards in the native embed
- fix(ui): keep the Sessions sidebar beside a terminal
- fix(ui): drop the floating-chrome gap above web pages without a sidebar
- test(ui): return to the Sessions page with Back in the roster request-rate e2e
- test(ui): follow page-decided sidebars in rail, Systems and Team e2e tests
- test(ui): read the People list on Activity in the people card e2e
- test(ui): check reconnect on the rail of a plugin page without a sidebar
- fix(ui): keep the Sessions list beside the Sessions page



## Update: no opening motion after a page without a sidebar

Going from a page without a sidebar (Dashboards, for example) to a page with one opened the sidebar with the collapse toggle's clip-path animation. It now appears at once, like closing already did; the explicit collapse/expand toggle keeps its motion.

- fix(ui): open a page's sidebar at once after a page without one
- `sidebar-rail-peek` e2e covers it: no `.shell-nav` clip-path transition on Dashboards → Automations, and one on the collapse toggle. It fails without the fix.

### Approved navigation-stack JS budget

Vyctor approved the measured JavaScript byte cost for this navigation stack. These cumulative measurements compare this layer with paired main base `1d82bed0a7fef79012c38ea7e6184911aba27e63`. Each cap equals the original main cap plus the measured delta, preserving existing headroom without adding another margin.

| Metric | Cumulative gzip delta | Cap |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Largest JS asset | +3,478 B | 575,918 B |
| Chat boot JS | +3,811 B | 1,329,391 B |
| New Session boot JS | +3,921 B | 820,553 B |

CSS ceilings, request counts, startup ceilings and gate logic are unchanged. Byte measurements are delivery-size evidence, not latency measurements.

Previously verified functional and integrated visual proof was reused where inputs are unchanged; the maintainer also exercised the integrated stack on a real Gateway.
